purpose: Deterministic offline benchmark fixtures for distributed knowledge access, regional practice, political fracture, reintegration, archive continuity, and sparse long-run context state. These are design/CI fixtures, not gameplay balance promises.

scenarios.description: A frontier research context is synchronized except for a new core discovery. Codified knowledge cannot be used locally before its communications path delivers the records.
assertions: destination cannot apply knowledge before delivery
expert/tooling/facility state is unchanged by data delivery

scenarios.description: A remote scientific region remains physically intact but loses long-distance communications for forty years. Its archives preserve theory while some experimental/engineering practice atrophies because training and major programs contract.
assertions: archive-backed theoretical competence remains substantially preserved
engineering practice may fall when real training/deployment practice disappears
reconnection can restore missing records faster than it restores engineering practice
no universal isolation research penalty is applied

scenarios.description: A mature interstellar polity fractures. Two successors inherit heavily overlapping foundational archives but different recent specialist records, experts, facilities, and tooling according to real context location.
assertions: both successors inherit shared widely replicated foundations
each successor inherits different specialist recent knowledge
neither successor receives the former polity complete technology set
located tacit assets follow inherited context rather than global ownership checkbox
missing former-polity recent knowledge may later be reacquired through normal research/exchange/recovery

scenarios.description: An isolated context loses its only actionable local archive for a small set of recent technologies. Historical references survive, then an external archive copy later restores formal knowledge without restoring lost practical expertise.
assertions: genuine single-copy archive destruction can remove local actionable access
external records can restore codified access
recovered records do not recreate experts, facilities, or engineering practice

scenarios.description: Reference 1,000-year continuity-state workload for a large civilization. Most regions remain synchronized and therefore never become explicit research contexts.
rules: normal synchronized regions allocate no explicit context
pending transmissions deduplicate by destination and revision
reintegrated contexts merge once deviations disappear
old event detail compresses into summaries
